name: german-language-distiller
description: Distill German language-course material (course books, lecture slides, handouts, notes) into compact study sheets (Wortschatz, Grammatik, Redemittel and a catchy story that reuses the lesson), written in your own words, then into an offline phone study app with German and English neural voices that repeat on tap, an examples-only listening mode, one-tap spaced-repetition flashcards, four lesson games and MP3 listening episodes.
